preparation_actions: Pasteurize chopped wheat straw in hot water bath or steam at 65-70 C for 1-2 h; drain and cool below 28 C before spawning.
colonisation_cautions: Keep ambient room air cooler (18-20 C) than internal core substrate temperature to prevent metabolic heat buildup above 35 C.
induction_actions: Open or cut slits in cultivation bag, lower ambient temperature to 10-16 C, increase fresh air exchange, and introduce indirect light to initiate pinning.
induction_light_action: Expose to ambient indirect light (500-1000 lux) for 10-12 hours daily.
induction_fresh_air_action: Increase fresh air exchange to reduce CO2 levels below 1000 ppm.
induction_other_actions: Cut X-slits or openings in bag walls for cluster emergence.
fruiting_cautions: Maintain high relative humidity without spraying water droplets directly onto developing caps; prevent cold draughts.
requirements_unresolved: None; baseline temperature drop and fresh air triggers well documented.
induction_source_reference: Penn State Extension (Royse, 2003); Ten Speed Press (Stamets, 2000)

preparation_actions: Pasteurize or lime-treat cottonseed hulls and wheat straw mixture; adjust substrate moisture to 68%.
colonisation_cautions: Monitor core substrate temperature continuously; ensure high room aeration to dissipate thermogenic heat and keep core below 35 C.
induction_actions: Open or slit bags, lower room temperature to 12-18 C, and introduce fresh air and light to trigger pinning.
induction_fresh_air_action: Increase fresh air ventilation to maintain CO2 below 1000 ppm and prevent stipe elongation.
induction_other_actions: Cut slits in bag walls for cluster emergence.
fruiting_cautions: Avoid high CO2 buildup which leads to long rubbery stems and small unexpanded caps.
requirements_unresolved: Cold shock requirement not explicitly stated for cottonseed hull substrate; temperature drop is a suggested transition.

preparation_actions: Autoclave supplemented hardwood sawdust (121 C for 90-120 min); cool completely in clean bench before spawning.
colonisation_cautions: Maintain sterile conditions during incubation to prevent weed mold contamination on bran-supplemented medium.
induction_actions: Uncap bottles or cut bag tops, lower room temperature to 10-15 C, increase fresh air and humidity to initiate pinning.
induction_fresh_air_action: Increase fresh air exchange to lower CO2 below 900 ppm.
induction_other_actions: Scratch top substrate surface (bokaki) if growing in bottles.
fruiting_cautions: High moisture and bran supplementation increase risk of bacterial blotch if free water accumulates on caps.
requirements_unresolved: Exact cold shock necessity for sawdust bags/bottles not explicitly specified.

preparation_actions: Pasteurize chopped wheat straw; drain thoroughly to 65% moisture and cool before spawning.
colonisation_cautions: Maintain incubation temperature around 22-26 C; avoid excessive moisture accumulation.
induction_actions: Open or slit cultivation bags, increase fresh-air exchange, maintain warm room temperature (18-22 C), and raise humidity to initiate pinning without cold shock.
induction_fresh_air_action: Increase fresh air exchange (4-8 air changes/hr) to keep CO2 below 1000 ppm.
induction_other_actions: Slit bags at multiple points for cluster initiation.
fruiting_cautions: Avoid cold draughts; strain prefers warm ambient conditions.
requirements_unresolved: None; explicitly documented that cold shock is NOT required.

preparation_actions: Prepare and pasteurize cotton waste / cottonseed hulls mix; adjust moisture to 68%.
colonisation_cautions: Ensure proper substrate drainage during incubation to prevent anaerobic waterlogging.
induction_actions: Open cultivation containers, provide fresh air exchange and warm fruiting conditions (18-23 C) with light to trigger pinning.
induction_fresh_air_action: Increase ventilation to maintain CO2 below 1000 ppm.
induction_other_actions: Slit or open bags for pinning.
fruiting_cautions: Prevent water droplets pooling on substrate surface.
requirements_unresolved: Specific physical induction trigger beyond bag opening and ventilation not documented.

preparation_actions: Sterilize bran-supplemented hardwood sawdust in autoclave; cool completely before spawning.
colonisation_cautions: Maintain clean aseptic environment during spawn run to prevent green mold.
induction_actions: Open bag tops or cut slits, transition to fruiting room (18-21 C), increase fresh air exchange, and provide light.
induction_fresh_air_action: Provide vigorous fresh air exchange to prevent CO2 accumulation above 1000 ppm.
induction_other_actions: Cut bag tops or side slits.
fruiting_cautions: Stipes elongate quickly if CO2 rises above threshold.
requirements_unresolved: Induction actions inferred from temperature transition and bag opening.

preparation_actions: Pasteurize chopped straw and lime treat (pH 7.5-8.5); drain to 65% moisture.
colonisation_cautions: Maintain warm incubation (24-28 C); NEVER allow substrate or ambient temperature to drop below 15 C.
induction_actions: Slit or open bags, maintain warm room conditions (20-25 C), increase relative humidity to 80-90%, and introduce light; DO NOT cold shock.
induction_fresh_air_action: Increase fresh air exchange to maintain CO2 below 1000 ppm.
induction_other_actions: Slit bags; ensure temperature stays strictly above 18 C.
fruiting_cautions: Cold exposure below 15 C damages or kills mycelium; harvest clusters quickly before heavy spore release.
requirements_unresolved: None; tropical temperature sensitivity and lack of cold shock well documented.

preparation_actions: Pasteurize or compost sugarcane bagasse / coffee pulp mixture; ensure balanced moisture (65%).
colonisation_cautions: Fast colonization generates heat; keep incubation area ventilated and warm.
induction_actions: Open or slit bags, maintain warm fruiting environment (20-26 C), introduce light and fresh air, and increase humidity.
induction_fresh_air_action: Provide steady fresh air exchange to keep CO2 below 1000 ppm.
induction_other_actions: Slit bags for cluster emergence.
fruiting_cautions: Heavy spore load; harvest pink clusters while caps are still convex.
requirements_unresolved: Specific physical induction trigger beyond bag slitting and ventilation not documented.
induction_source_reference: Ten Speed Press (Stamets, 2000); CRC Press (Chang & Miles, 2004)

preparation_actions: Sterilize supplemented hardwood sawdust in autoclave; cool to room temperature before spawning.
colonisation_cautions: Keep room warm (22-27 C) throughout incubation.
induction_actions: Open bag tops or cut side slits, maintain warm room temperature (20-25 C), increase fresh air, and maintain humidity above 80%.
induction_fresh_air_action: Increase fresh air exchange to lower CO2 below 900 ppm.
induction_other_actions: Cut bag tops or side slits.
fruiting_cautions: Low humidity (<75%) results in thin, brittle, malformed caps.
requirements_unresolved: Specific induction trigger inferred from bag opening and environmental shift.

preparation_actions: Autoclave hardwood sawdust supplemented with 15-20% bran and 1% gypsum/CaCO3 at 121 C for 90-120 min.
colonisation_cautions: Complete incubation in dark at 20-24 C; prevent contamination on rich substrate.
induction_actions: Lower room temperature to 15 C (cold shock), introduce light (500-1000 lux), scratch top substrate surface if in bottles (bokaki), and adjust CO2 to 1000-2000 ppm.
induction_light_action: Expose to indirect light (500-1000 lux) for 10-12 hours daily to trigger pinning.
induction_fresh_air_action: Increase fresh air exchange to bring CO2 down to 1000-2000 ppm (keep CO2 slightly elevated during stem development).
induction_other_actions: Scratch substrate surface (bokaki) when uncapping bottles; or open bag top.
fruiting_cautions: Do not drop CO2 too low if thick commercial stems are desired; maintain high humidity during pin development.
requirements_unresolved: None; temperature drop target (15 C), light, and surface scratching explicitly documented.
induction_source_reference: Ten Speed Press (Stamets, 2000); Penn State Extension (Royse, 2003)

preparation_actions: Chop wheat straw (2-5 cm), pasteurize or lime treat, and drain to 65% moisture.
colonisation_cautions: Ensure thorough colonisation before initiating fruiting.
induction_actions: Subject colonized straw bags to cold induction (drop temperature to 13-16 C), slit bags, introduce light, and raise humidity.
induction_fresh_air_action: Increase fresh air exchange to keep CO2 around 1000-1800 ppm.
induction_other_actions: Slit cultivation bags.
fruiting_cautions: Lower biological yield on unsupplemented straw compared to enriched sawdust.
requirements_unresolved: Exact cold shock duration on straw substrate not specified in source.

preparation_actions: Blend cottonseed hulls, corncobs, 15% wheat bran, and 1% lime; sterilize at 121 C in bottles or bags.
colonisation_cautions: Maintain dark incubation at 20-24 C until substrate is fully colonized.
induction_actions: Drop room temperature to 15 C to trigger a uniform pinhead flush, uncap bottles/bags, scratch top mycelium surface, introduce light and humidity.
induction_fresh_air_action: Adjust ventilation to maintain CO2 between 1000-2000 ppm.
induction_other_actions: Perform mechanical surface scratching (bokaki) on bottle tops.
fruiting_cautions: Ensure uniform temperature drop across entire growing room for synchronized flushing.
requirements_unresolved: None; 15 C temperature drop and bottle scratching explicitly documented.

preparation_actions: Autoclave hardwood sawdust supplemented with 15-20% wheat bran and 1% gypsum/CaCO3 at 121 C for 2 hours; cool completely.
colonisation_cautions: Allow initial colonisation (20-25 d), then continue vegetative incubation for popcorn blister formation and exterior coat browning (45-90 d total).
induction_actions: Strip plastic bag completely from mature browned block, submerge in cold water (10-12 C) for 12-24 hours, apply physical shock (slapping or dropping block), and place in fruiting room with light and fresh air.
induction_light_action: Expose to bright indirect light (500-1000 lux) during browning and fruiting.
induction_fresh_air_action: Provide fresh air exchange to lower CO2 below 1000 ppm.
induction_humidity_action: Raise relative humidity to 85-90% during pinning, then 80-85% during cap growth.
induction_other_actions: Complete block maturation/browning (45-90 d total) before stripping bag; soak block in cold water for 12-24 hours and apply physical shock.
fruiting_cautions: Premature removal of bag before full browning leads to block contamination and poor pinning.
requirements_unresolved: Exact browning duration varies by strain (45-90 days); cold soak temperature (10-12 C) and duration (12-24 h) well established.
induction_source_reference: Penn State Extension (Royse, 2001); Ten Speed Press (Stamets, 2000); ICAR-DMR Solan (2020)

preparation_actions: Cut fresh healthy hardwood logs (oak/beech) during dormant season; drill inoculation holes, insert sawdust/plug spawn, and seal with hot cheese wax.
colonisation_cautions: Stack logs in shaded laying yards for 6-12 months; monitor log moisture and prevent drying out or soil contact.
induction_actions: Immerse fully colonized logs completely in cold water for 24-48 hours, knock/impact log ends on ground (physical shock), and move to fruiting yard/A-frame stacks.
induction_light_action: Maintain logs in partial shade / ambient outdoor light.
induction_fresh_air_action: Outdoor natural air flow.
induction_humidity_action: Keep fruiting area humid (80-90% RH) via overhead misting.
induction_other_actions: Cold water immersion soaking for 24-48 hours; physical end-shocking.
fruiting_cautions: Unsoaked logs fruit sparsely or only after natural heavy rain events.
requirements_unresolved: None; outdoor log soaking (24-48 h) and physical shock well documented.

preparation_actions: Autoclave hardwood sawdust supplemented with 15-20% wheat bran and 1% gypsum at 121 C for 90-120 min.
colonisation_cautions: Keep incubation room completely dark; protect bags from light leaks or punctures to prevent premature in-bag pinning.
induction_actions: Cut small X-slits in bag walls, lower ambient temperature to 16-20 C, introduce fresh air to reduce CO2 below 1000 ppm, and provide light.
induction_fresh_air_action: Increase fresh air exchange to lower CO2 below 1000 ppm (CO2 >1200 ppm suppresses downward icicle spines).
induction_other_actions: Cut small slits in bag walls.
fruiting_cautions: High CO2 causes cauliflower-like ball growth without spines; avoid direct water spraying onto developing spines.
requirements_unresolved: Cold shock requirement not explicitly established; temperature transition and light/oxygen exposure are primary triggers.
induction_source_reference: Ten Speed Press (Stamets, 2000); UN CSAM (2020); ICAR-DMR Solan (2020)

substrate: Master's mix (50% hardwood sawdust + 50% soybean hulls)
preparation_actions: Mix 50% hardwood sawdust and 50% soybean hulls at 62% moisture; autoclave at 121 C for 2 hours.
colonisation_cautions: High nutrient medium colonizes rapidly; maintain dark, clean incubation environment.
induction_actions: Cut small X-slits in bag, transfer to fruiting room (16-18 C), introduce fresh air, and maintain humidity above 88%.
induction_fresh_air_action: Increase fresh air ventilation to keep CO2 below 900 ppm.
induction_humidity_action: Maintain high relative humidity strictly at 88-95% to prevent spine drying.
induction_other_actions: Cut small X-slits in bag walls.
fruiting_cautions: High humidity required to avoid spine yellowing and browning.
requirements_unresolved: Induction temperature target inferred from fruiting optimum.

preparation_actions: Pasteurize chopped straw or cottonseed hulls; drain to 65% moisture.
colonisation_cautions: Protect bags from premature light exposure during colonisation.
induction_actions: Slit bags at multiple points, lower temperature to 18-20 C, introduce fresh air and indirect light.
induction_fresh_air_action: Provide fresh air exchange to maintain CO2 below 1000 ppm.
induction_other_actions: Cut slits in bag walls.
fruiting_cautions: Do not spray water droplets directly onto developing spines to avoid bacterial discoloration.
requirements_unresolved: Cold shock requirement not documented for straw substrate.

preparation_actions: Autoclave hardwood sawdust supplemented with 15-20% bran, 1% CaCO3, and 1% gypsum at 121 C for 2 hours.
colonisation_cautions: Allow mycelium to form a dense white leathery top mantle; keep incubation warm (24-30 C).
induction_actions: Cut bag top or remove plug, expose to light, maintain warm fruiting temperature (21-27 C), raise humidity to 80-90%, and set CO2 according to desired shape (<2000 ppm for conk/cap, >2000 ppm for antler).
induction_light_action: Provide bright indirect light (500-1000 lux) to induce cap development and reddish-brown lacquering.
induction_fresh_air_action: Control fresh air exchange based on morphology: high ventilation (<2000 ppm CO2) for broad conks; restricted ventilation (>2000-20000 ppm CO2) for branched antlers.
induction_other_actions: Cut top of bag or uncap bottle; adjust CO2 for desired conk vs. antler morphology.
fruiting_cautions: Harvest when white growing margin disappears and cap becomes completely lacquered reddish-brown.
requirements_unresolved: None; light induction and CO2 morphological control well documented.
induction_source_reference: Ten Speed Press (Stamets, 2000); MushWorld (2004); ICAR-DMR Solan (2020)

preparation_actions: Prepare cottonseed hulls with 10% wheat bran and 1% gypsum; adjust moisture to 65% and pasteurize or autoclave.
colonisation_cautions: Incubate at 24-30 C in dark.
induction_actions: Open or slit bags, introduce light and fresh air, maintain warm temperature (20-30 C), and raise humidity to 80-90%.
induction_fresh_air_action: Increase fresh air exchange to lower CO2 below 2000 ppm for conk production.
induction_other_actions: Open or slit bags.
fruiting_cautions: Ensure substrate remains warm; harvest when cap margin darkens completely.
requirements_unresolved: Specific physical induction trigger inferred from bag opening and light exposure.

preparation_actions: Drill oak billets, inoculate with spawn, seal with wax, and incubate logs until colonized.
colonisation_cautions: Protect logs from drying during incubation.
induction_actions: Bury colonized logs/billets upright in sand/soil beds, expose to ambient light and fresh air, maintain high moisture via bed watering.
induction_fresh_air_action: Outdoor / greenhouse ambient air flow.
induction_humidity_action: Keep sand/soil bed moist and maintain 80-90% ambient relative humidity.
induction_other_actions: Bury billets upright in moist sand/soil beds.
fruiting_cautions: Takes 30-60 days for full conk development and lacquering.
requirements_unresolved: None; log burial in sand beds is established practice.

preparation_actions: Autoclave hardwood sawdust with 20% rice bran at 121 C for 2 hours; cool completely.
colonisation_cautions: Incubate at 18-25 C in dark until substrate is fully colonized.
induction_actions: Uncap/open container, apply cold shock by dropping room temperature to 10-14 C under low CO2 (<1000 ppm) and light to initiate pinning; once pins form, attach plastic collars and lower temperature further to 3-8 C with elevated CO2 (2000-4000 ppm) to elongate stipes.
induction_light_action: Expose to dim light during initial pinning (10-14 C), then keep dark/dim during stipe elongation (3-8 C).
induction_fresh_air_action: Provide fresh air exchange (CO2 <1000 ppm) during initial pinning stage; then attach collars to restrict air exchange and trap 2000-4000 ppm CO2 during stipe elongation.
induction_other_actions: Attach plastic paper collars around container top to retain CO2 and force vertical stem elongation; lower temperature to 3-8 C after pinning.
fruiting_cautions: If CO2 is too low during elongation stage, stems will be short and caps will expand prematurely; if temperature is too high, caps turn brown.
requirements_unresolved: None; biphasic temperature drop (10-14 C pinning -> 3-8 C elongation) and collar attachment explicitly documented.
induction_source_reference: Ten Speed Press (Stamets, 2000); CRC Press (Chang & Miles, 2004); ICAR-DMR Solan (2020)

preparation_actions: Blend corncob meal, 20% rice bran, and 1% CaCO3; fill bottles and autoclave at 121 C for 2 hours.
colonisation_cautions: Incubate bottles at 18-22 C in dark.
induction_actions: Uncap bottles, perform mechanical surface scratching (bakaki) to scrape off top mycelium layer, drop temperature to 10-14 C to trigger pinning, then fit collars and drop temperature to 3-8 C.
induction_light_action: Dim light during pinning, dark during collar elongation phase.
induction_fresh_air_action: Low CO2 (<1000 ppm) during pinning; elevated CO2 (2000-4000 ppm) under collar during stem growth.
induction_other_actions: Perform mechanical surface scratching (bakaki) on bottle tops; attach paper/plastic collars.
fruiting_cautions: Precise temperature control required across cold shock and elongation phases.
requirements_unresolved: None; surface scratching (bakaki) and collar application well documented.
